mapper.sql: pmio.id id,pmio.org_id orgId,pmio.patient_id patientId,pmio.member_type_id memberTypeId,pmio.master_card masterCard,pmio.card_number cardNumber, pmio.status status,pmio.principal_amount principalAmount,pmio.bonus_amount bonusAmount,pmio.point point,pmio.last_expired_time lastExpiredTime, pmio.next_expired_time nextExpiredTime,pmio.remarks remarks,pmio.inservice inservice
mapper.select: select pmio.org_id orgId, pmio.patient_id, pmio.id,pmio.card_number cardNumber,pmio.member_type_id memberTypeId,pmio.crt_time crtTime,pbio.name name, CAST((pmio.principal_amount+pmio.bonus_amount) AS decimal(15,2)) memberCardMoneySum, CAST(IFNULL(pmio.principal_amount,0) AS decimal(15,2)) principalAmount, CAST(IFNULL(pmio.bonus_amount,0) AS decimal(15,2)) bonusAmount from patient_member_info pmio join patient_base_info pbio on pmio.patient_id = pbio.id where pmio.patient_id =#{id}

select IF(card_number is null,'000000',substr( MAX(card_number), 6, 6 )) as maxnum from patient_member_info where org_id = #{orgId}
and date_format(crt_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') >= date_format(#{onlineDateTime},'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')

select IF(prepayment_number is null,'000000',substr( MAX(prepayment_number), 6, 6 )) as maxnum from patient_prepayments_info where org_id = #{orgId}
and date_format(crt_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') >= date_format(#{onlineDateTime},'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')

select
from patient_member_info pmio where pmio.card_number = #{cardNumber}

select
from patient_member_info pmio where pmio.card_number = #{memberCard}

select
from patient_member_info pmio where pmio.patient_id =#{patientId}

SELECT pmio.id id, pmio.org_id orgid, pmio.patient_id patientId, pmio.card_number cardNumber, pmio.crt_time crtTime, pbio.NAME NAME, CAST(IFNULL( pmio.principal_amount + pmio.bonus_amount, 0 ) AS DECIMAL ( 15, 2 )) memberCardMoneySum, CAST(IFNULL( pmio.principal_amount, 0 ) AS DECIMAL ( 15, 2 )) principalAmount, CAST(IFNULL( pmio.bonus_amount, 0 ) AS DECIMAL ( 15, 2 )) bonusAmount FROM patient_member_relation pmrn join patient_member_info pmio on pmrn.secondary_card_id = pmio.patient_id join patient_base_info pbio on pmio.patient_id = pbio.id where pmrn.master_card_id =#{id} and pmrn.bind_type = 1
